verdict: TRAP-VERIFY KILL — SCREEN-MISCLASSIFIED, and the kill indicts the SCREEN'S QUALITY INPUTS, not just the name. (1) The drawdown IS gold beta: gold -21.1% from its Jan-2026 peak vs AGI -38.0% = 1.80x, ordinary senior-producer beta, no idiosyncratic gap to close. (2) The quality metrics that admitted it are windfall artifacts — the 70.8% 'gross margin' is a CASH-COST construction excluding D&A and ALL capital, not commensurable with the non-extractive cohort it was percentile-ranked against, and the 27.4% ROE is computed on a Q2 realized price of $4,504/oz. (3) fwd_rev_growth of 27.6% is 100% PRICE DECK: guided VOLUME was cut 570-650koz to 510-560koz (-12% mid) and AISC raised — real forward production growth is NEGATIVE. (4) At record gold it generated ~$51M FCF on ~$14.5B cap = ~1.4% FCF yield at the cycle peak, with two-thirds of IGD growth capex still ahead.
lane: quality_drawdown (first courts ever run from this lane)
reopen_gates: NONE. Extractive producers do not belong in this lane until the screen carries all-in-cost margins and VOLUME-based forward growth.
adjudicator_note: quality_drawdown lane, first wave 2026-08-17, all benches Opus
